name: Hierapolis-Pamukkale
description: In southwestern Türkiye, hot springs have coated a hillside above the Menderes valley with gleaming white travertine, forming terraced pools and frozen-looking cascades that give Pamukkale its name, "Cotton Castle." On top of this natural staircase lie the ruins of Hierapolis, a spa city founded by the kings of Pergamon in the 2nd century B.C. Visitors can wander among its baths and temples.
